Two Indian states form committees to draft Uniform Civil Code

Maharashtra and West Bengal have established committees to draft legislation for a Uniform Civil Code (UCC). Maharashtra's seven-member panel is headed by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, while West Bengal's nine-member committee also includes Justice Desai. The move signifies progress towards potentially unifying personal civil laws across these states.
